controls: One frozen executable links the qualified accepted BN254 library. The reference uses the current two-vector eight-element Fq2 formulas. The candidate uses two one-vector four-element packs, so both modes calculate the same eight elements.

gate.affine_expression: Paired median candidate/reference ratio <1 and at least 21/31 winning blocks.
gate.aggregate: Geometric mean of four paired pattern medians <1 and at least 21/31 aggregate winning blocks.
gate.correctness: All new independent Arkworks and curve/arithmetic oracles must pass before timing.
gate.no_retry: No minimum positive-gain floor, selective exclusion, parameter sweep or unchanged reroll. A failed gate closes this component before any SDK integration. A passing gate only motivates a separately declared complete-stream/SDK experiment.

hypothesis: Packing four Fq2 elements as four real lanes followed by four imaginary lanes can shorten the live register set of complex arithmetic without changing the underlying accepted field operations.
implementation: Existing Ifma8::halves/from_halves, Ifma::sub and Ifma8::sum2/mul/add/sub only. No new Montgomery kernel, assembly, heap buffer, key table or persistent state.
profiles: After all unprofiled measurements, one cycles:u 999 Hz capture per mode for 20000000 affine-expression iterations. Record actual linked kernel assembly and static instruction/IFMA/stack-reference counts. Component profiles are explanatory, not SDK or isolated spill-cost claims.
publication: Commit and push the completed experiment, including a negative result. Preserve accepted production manifest and executable.
scope: Native arithmetic component only; no prover dispatch or SDK latency claim

timing.checks: Every final canonical Fq value in every output state and updated scale must agree across modes in the corresponding pattern/block, not only a checksum. All results and failures retained; no owned CPU overlap.
timing.inside: Repeated changing-state arithmetic, final optimizer barrier; preparation of initial scalar inputs and packing, output conversion/checking, formatting outside timer.
timing.order: Rotate patterns by block; rotate mode order by pattern plus block and reverse on odd blocks.
